data.name: Satyaban
data.gender_notes: Satyaban is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Satyam', meaning truth or reality. Satyaban is a name for someone who embodies truth and honesty in all aspects of their life. The name Satyaban carries the meaning “Truth, Sincerity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Satyaban usually hope their child will grow to embody truth, sincerity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a seeker of truth, a name for someone who values integrity and honesty above all else.
data.etymology: Satyaban belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truth, Sincerity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Satyaban total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Satyaban holds significant cultural importance in Hindu tradition, particularly in India. In Sanskrit literature, the word 'Satya' (truth) is considered a sacred and virtuous concept, often embedded in various stories and teachings, inspiring generations to uphold truthfulness as a core value. A person named Satyaban is therefore perceived as someone who reflects the highest moral and ethical ideals, profoundly impacting their community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu philosophy, Satyavada ('path of truth') is one of the four atheistic paths to attain enlightenment and Moksha, the ultimate freedom from the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. Named Satyaban, an individual is continuously encouraged to address the moral dimensions of their actions and thoughts, striving to live a Truthful life, leading to spiritual growth and communion with the divine.
